meta.name: securability-engineering-review
meta.description: Analyze a software project using the official SSEM scoring and reporting model. Use when assessing code securability, producing an SSEM scorecard, generating a structured SSEM evaluation report, reviewing merge requests through a securable engineering lens, or establishing a security posture baseline. Complements vulnerability-centric reviews by focusing on whether code is engineered to remain understandable, modifiable, trustworthy, and reliable over time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 SSEM 模型分析代码的可维护性、可信赖性和可靠性，并生成包含评分、详细发现和检查清单的结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你要求评估代码安全性、生成 SSEM 评分卡或审查合并请求时，Claude 会触发该技能。

say.text: 请用 SSEM 模型评估这个项目的代码安全性。
say.note: Claude 会要求补充项目信息并生成完整报告。

say.text: 分析这个合并请求的可维护性和可信赖性。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦于代码工程质量进行审查。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes code for maintainability, trustworthiness, and reliability using the SSEM model, producing a structured report with scores, detailed findings, and a checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to assess code securability, generate an SSEM scorecard, or review merge requests through a securable engineering lens.

say_en.text: Evaluate this project's code security using the SSEM model.
